bug_description: Heap-use-after-free in CleanNode (gdoc.c:112) when TidyGDocClean option is enabled. CleanNode traverses the DOM tree using a saved next pointer (next = child->next). When DiscardElement frees a node via FreeNode -> defaultDealloc during the current iteration, the saved next pointer becomes stale, pointing to freed heap memory. The subsequent dereference of this stale pointer on the next loop iteration causes a READ of size 8 on freed memory. The crash is triggered through the public API (tidyCreate + tidyParseString + tidyCleanAndRepair) when processing crafted HTML with Google Docs-style markup and TidyGDocClean enabled.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu
cd /src/tidy-html5

mkdir -p build && cd build
cmake -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" \
    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" \
    ..
make -j$(nproc)
cd ..

# Find the static library and compile harness
TIDY_LIB=$(find build -name "libtidy*.a" -print -quit)
clang -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
    -I include \
    /src/harness.c \
    "$TIDY_LIB" \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR tidy-html5.issue-1175..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.html
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/tidy-html5
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi

    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \

bug_report:
Use-after-free in CleanNode (gdoc.c:112) when TidyGDocClean is enabled

Component: src/gdoc.c (CleanNode function, line 112)

CleanNode traverses the DOM tree iteratively using a stack. For each child node, it saves next = child->next before processing. Several branches call DiscardElement(doc, child) which frees the child node via FreeNode -> defaultDealloc. When DiscardElement frees a node, the previously saved next pointer may become stale if it pointed to memory that was part of the freed allocation region.

Call chain:
  tidyCleanAndRepair -> tidyDocCleanAndRepair -> prvTidyCleanGoogleDocument
  -> CleanNode (UAF READ at line 112)

Free chain:
  CleanNode (line 111) -> prvTidyDiscardElement -> prvTidyFreeNode -> free

PoC: 90-byte crafted HTML with Google Docs-style markup. First byte is an options byte (0x80 enables TidyGDocClean). The HTML contains span/style elements that trigger the discard path in CleanNode.

CWE: CWE-416 (Use After Free)
Severity: The UAF READ could potentially be exploited for information disclosure or could lead to further heap corruption depending on heap layout.
